purpose: Builds W3C TDMRep AI-training rights reservation records from a reservation flag, optional location scope pattern, optional policy URL, and optional ISCC content reference. Outputs a tdmrep.json rule array, HTTP Content-Usage header equivalents, and HTML meta-tag equivalents per the W3C TDM Reservation Protocol and IETF AIPREF draft.
